svg.text: The crew button is a scene
Hold to start, one tap to
Every crew moment is the same thing underneath: a request to the arbiter with a template, content, a chain of regions, zones and a duration.
The phone never sends a screen anything directly; the arbiter ranks, places, times and reverts, so a crew member cannot break the screen.
Rights decide which buttons show: announce (moments.announce), urgent (moments.announce.urgent), spotlight and storyboards (moments.take),
scenes (moments.scenes.take), emergency (moments.emergency: the event admin, and the superadmin venue-wide).
